data-blora-thread.description: Marks a thread root (optional; class .blora-thread is enough for styling)

data-blora-thread-replies.description: Reply list container that can be collapsed

data-blora-thread-body.description: Animated body inside the reply list

data-blora-thread-toggle.description: Collapse/expand control for the nearest replies box (use a regular blora-button with data-variant="outline")

data-blora-thread-comment-fold.description: Toggle for a long comment body: collapses the nearest .blora-thread-comment (data-collapsed)

data-blora-thread-tab.description: Composer tab (data-tab="edit"|"preview"); toggles data-active and the composer's data-tab state

data-collapsed.description: Collapsed state for a reply list or comment body

data-active.description: Active state for a reaction button or tab

data-label-expand.description: Per-button expand label (default 展开评论)

data-label-collapse.description: Per-button collapse label (default 收起评论)

createThreadController.description: Create a thread controller for the declared data-attribute structure: expand/collapse replies and long comments, post + comment reactions, and composer tabs
